name_zh: 缅甸·奈温：军事隔离与佛教迷信经济自毁
name_en: Myanmar Ne Win: Military Isolation & Buddhist Superstition Economy Self-Destruction
description_zh: 奈温 (1911-2002) 缅甸军事独裁者 (1962-1988)，建立缅甸式社会主义孤立经济，1987年废除货币依迷信数字(9的倍数)，引发8888起义，晚年居家监禁，军事隔离与经济自毁导致缅甸从东南亚富庶沦为最不发达。
description_en: Ne Win (1911-2002) Myanmar military dictator (1962-1988), built Burmese Way to Socialism isolated economy, 1987 demonetized currency based on superstition number (multiples of 9), triggered 8888 uprising, late house arrest, military isolation and economic self-destruction reduced Myanmar from Southeast Asia prosperity to LDC.
reason_zh: 奈温代表军事独裁与经济愚昧的毁灭性结合，展示了迷信决策如何摧毁国家经济基础，其"缅甸式社会主义"成为发展经济学反面教材，军事隔离导致国家彻底边缘化。
reason_en: Ne Win represents destructive fusion of military dictatorship and economic folly, demonstrating how superstitious decision-making destroys national economic foundation, his Burmese Way to Socialism became development economics cautionary tale, military isolation led to complete national marginalization.
steps_zh: 研究奈温早年三十同志与昂山副手关系
分析1962年政变建立革命委员会与缅甸式社会主义
探讨1964年国有化与1987年迷信废币灾难
评估8888起义与1988年辞职权力交接给素貌
总结军事隔离佛教迷信经济自毁对缅甸发展的世纪创伤
steps_en: Study Ne Win early Thirty Comrades and Aung San deputy relationship
Analyze 1962 coup established Revolutionary Council and Burmese Way to Socialism
Explore 1964 nationalization and 1987 superstitious demonetization disaster
Evaluate 8888 uprising and 1988 resignation power transfer to Saw Maung
Summarize military isolation Buddhist superstition economy self-destruction century trauma for Myanmar development
expected_zh: 理解军事强权如何通过意识形态合法化经济愚昧，掌握迷信决策在封闭体制中放大破坏力的机制，评估奈温遗产对缅甸当代经济重建的深度阻碍。
expected_en: Understand how military power legitimizes economic folly through ideology, grasp superstition decision-making amplification mechanism in closed system, evaluate Ne Win legacy deep hindrance for Myanmar contemporary economic reconstruction.
case_zh: 1962 政变；1964 国有化；1987 迷信废币；1988 8888起义辞职；2002 逝世。军事隔离佛教迷信经济自毁范式永存。
case_en: 1962 coup; 1964 nationalization; 1987 superstitious demonetization; 1988 8888 uprising resignation; 2002 death. Military isolation Buddhist superstition economy self-destruction paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Military isolation; economic self-destruction; superstition policy; LDC decline
